result.instructions: Tools for sevdesk, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes sevdesk data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run sevdesk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sevdesk_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sevdesk_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. sevdesk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sevdesk_get_bookkeeping_system_version
tools.title: Get the bookkeeping system version
tools.description: Return whether the account runs sevdesk bookkeeping 1.0 or 2.0 (2.0 uses taxRule instead of taxType on invoices). Also a cheap way to confirm the API token works. sevdesk: GET /Tools/bookkeepingSystemVersion.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers, suppliers, partners, prospects). By default sevdesk returns only organisations; set include_persons to also get individual persons. sevdesk: GET /Contact.

include_persons.description: If true, return organisations AND persons (sevdesk depth=1). Default: organisations only.

name.description: Only contacts whose name, first name or last name matches.

customer_number.description: Only the contact with this customer number.

zip.description: Only contacts with this ZIP code.

category_id.description: Only contacts in this category: 2 Supplier, 3 Customer, 4 Partner, 28 Prospect customer.

parent_id.description: Only persons belonging to this parent organisation's id.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip, for paging.

count_all.description: If true, the response also carries `total`, the full match count.

embed.description: Comma-separated nested resources to expand inline, e.g. contact,category.

tools.name: sevdesk_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact. Give `name` for an organisation, or `surename`/`familyname` for a person. Addresses and emails are separate (use sevdesk_add_communication_way). sevdesk: POST /Contact.

name.description: Organisation name. Setting it makes the contact an ORGANISATION — leave empty for a person.

surename.description: First name of a PERSON (sevdesk's field is really spelled 'surename').

customer_number.description: Customer number. Omit to let sevdesk leave it unset.

default_time_to_pay.description: Default payment term in days for this contact's invoices.

parent_id.description: For a person: the id of the organisation they belong to.

category_id.description: Required category: 2 Supplier, 3 Customer, 4 Partner, 28 Prospect customer.

tools.name: sevdesk_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact; only the fields you pass are sent. sevdesk: PUT /Contact/{contactId}.

name.description: Organisation name. Setting it makes the contact an ORGANISATION — leave empty for a person.

surename.description: First name of a PERSON (sevdesk's field is really spelled 'surename').

customer_number.description: Customer number. Omit to let sevdesk leave it unset.

default_time_to_pay.description: Default payment term in days for this contact's invoices.

parent_id.description: For a person: the id of the organisation they belong to.

category_id.description: Move to category: 2 Supplier, 3 Customer, 4 Partner, 28 Prospect.

tools.name: sevdesk_add_communication_way
tools.title: Add an email, phone or website to a contact
tools.description: Attach an email address, phone/mobile number or website to a contact. key_id labels it (2 Arbeit/work is a good default; see sevdesk_list_communication_way_keys). sevdesk: POST /CommunicationWay.

type.description: What kind of value this is.

value.description: The email address, number or URL.

key_id.description: Communication way key id (1 Privat, 2 Arbeit, 3 Fax, 4 Mobil, 8 Rechnungsadresse). Default 2.

main.description: Make this the contact's main communication way of its type.

annotations.title: Add an email, phone or website to a contact

tools.name: sevdesk_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create a draft invoice
tools.description: Create a normal invoice (type RE) with its line items, ALWAYS saved as a DRAFT (status 100): it is not sent, not booked and stays editable in sevdesk. contact_person_id is the sevdesk USER responsible for it — copy contactPerson.id from any existing invoice (sevdesk_get_invoice). Bookkeeping 2.0 accounts use tax_rule_id (1 = taxable sales in Germany, the usual choice); 1.0 accounts pass tax_type instead (check sevdesk_get_bookkeeping_system_version). sevdesk: POST /Invoice/Factory/saveInvoice.

contact_person_id.description: Id of the sevdesk user (SevUser) acting as contact person — e.g. contactPerson.id of an existing invoice.

price.description: Unit price — net if show_net is true (default), otherwise gross.

tax_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 19, 7 or 0.

text.description: Longer description shown under the name.

part_id.description: Link the line to this inventory part id.

tax_rule_id.description: Bookkeeping 2.0 VAT rule id. 1 taxable sales (Umsatzsteuerpflichtige Umsätze), 2 exports, 3 intra-EU supplies, 4 tax-free §4 UStG, 5 reverse charge §13b, 11 small business §19 (Kleinunternehmer), 17 not taxable in Germany, 18-20 One Stop Shop, 21 reverse charge §18b. Default 1.

tax_type.description: Bookkeeping 1.0 only — leave unset on 2.0 accounts.

tax_text.description: VAT text printed on the invoice. Default 'Umsatzsteuer 19%'.

address_country_id.description: sevdesk StaticCountry id of the billing address (1 = Germany). Default 1.

address.description: Complete recipient address with line breaks. Omit to leave it empty.

head_text.description: Text above the line items (some HTML allowed).

foot_text.description: Text below the line items (some HTML allowed).

delivery_date.description: Delivery / service date as dd.mm.yyyy (must not be after invoice_date for a normal invoice).

show_net.description: If true (default), position prices are net.

small_settlement.description: True if the account uses the small-business scheme (no VAT).
